Implementation notes

Treat this as a breaking 6.0 cutover. Remove Claude marketplace manifests, hooks, agents, setup/runtime branches, model routing, session identity fallbacks, provider dependencies, tests, and eval cases. Preserve accurate historical ADRs and archived plans with supersession notes. Retain ambient credential scrubbing and dependency-lock entries required transitively by Promptfoo because those are safety/dependency facts rather than supported Claude behavior.
event_data.summary: The repository currently maintains Claude Code distribution and runtime surfaces even though future development will target Codex alone. Remove those duplicate paths so installation, setup, model routing, task coordination, evaluations, and current guidance present one supported Codex workflow. This reduces maintenance cost, prevents the two harness surfaces from drifting, and makes release evidence match the product direction.
event_data.title: Make the marketplace exclusively support Codex
